feature.name: Chat-native Deep Research with Agent Reach
feature.summary: Move Deep Research initiation and follow-up into ordinary chat through /research while preserving the existing Deep Research report page and extending source acquisition with optional Agent Reach channels.
feature.source_task: User request: combine the existing Deep Research workflow with Panniantong/agent-reach and make it usable and follow-up capable from ordinary chat.
principles: Extend the existing Deep Research engine; do not create a second research subsystem.
Keep one ordinary chat composer and use /research <query> instead of a Chat/Research mode toggle.
The same ResearchRun must power both the inline chat experience and the standalone Deep Research page.
Completed research must be inserted into the originating Pi session so subsequent chat messages can follow it up.
Agent Reach is an optional source provider; existing web tools remain the fallback.
Do not automatically install system packages, access browser cookies, or enable authenticated channels.
user_flow: The user enters /research <question> in the ordinary chat composer.
ChatView starts the existing start_deep_research command with the current chat and Pi session as origin metadata.
An inline research card shows state, activity, source counts, and cancel or resume actions.
The existing isolated research Pi session uses built-in web tools and healthy enabled Agent Reach channels.
When complete, the report is handed to the originating Pi session and rendered inline in chat.
The user can immediately ask follow-up questions in the same chat.
Open full report navigates to the same run in the standalone Deep Research page.

phases.name: Replace research mode with /research
scope: Remove the Chat/Research composer mode toggle from ChatView.
Register /research in the ordinary chat slash-command list.
Parse /research <query>, reject an empty query, and preserve the existing confirmation before starting a token-consuming run.
Start the existing ResearchRun with origin_chat_id and origin_session_id.
Do not change normal prompt, follow-up, steer, attachment, model, or thinking behavior.
acceptance_criteria: /research <query> starts exactly one existing Deep Research run.
/research without a query shows an actionable validation message and starts nothing.
Ordinary chat no longer requires switching composer modes.
Only one active Deep Research run remains allowed, matching current backend behavior.

phases.name: Render research runs inside chat
scope: Render originating ResearchRun records as inline chat cards in chronological context.
Show current state, progress activity, searches, reads, checks, elapsed time, partial failure details, and source count.
Expose existing cancel and resume commands from the inline card.
Render the completed report inline and provide Open full report using onOpenResearch(run.id).
Keep the standalone Deep Research page and its local history unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Research progress updates without leaving the chat.
Completed reports are readable directly in chat.
Open full report opens the identical ResearchRun on the Deep Research page.
Reloading the app restores the run from the existing persisted research store.

phases.name: Make completed research follow-up capable
scope: Reuse handoff_deep_research to deliver the final report to the originating Pi session exactly once.
Keep report content wrapped as untrusted reference material.
Surface handoff failure on the inline card and allow a safe retry.
Do not switch views or silently create a new chat after handoff.
acceptance_criteria: A completed report becomes context for the same originating chat session.
A normal follow-up question can reference findings from the report without pasting it again.
Duplicate events or app reloads do not inject the same report twice.
A failed handoff does not mark the run as delivered.

phases.name: Add Agent Reach as an optional research source provider
scope: Integrate Panniantong/agent-reach with the existing isolated Deep Research Pi session, preferably through its structured MCP integration.
Add an app-owned availability and health check using agent-reach doctor.
Enable public, low-risk channels first: web, GitHub, YouTube, RSS, and Exa when available.
Teach the research prompt to choose source-specific channels and prioritize primary sources.
Collect Agent Reach result URLs into the existing ResearchRun source and citation-validation flow.
Fall back to web_search, source_check, fetch_content, and get_search_content when Agent Reach is unavailable or a channel fails.
acceptance_criteria: Deep Research still completes when Agent Reach is not installed.
When healthy, Agent Reach public channels can be selected by the research agent.
Agent Reach source URLs participate in the existing structured citation checks.
Failure of one Agent Reach channel does not fail the whole run when fallback sources remain available.
Ordinary non-research chat behavior is unchanged.

phases.name: Add explicit health and security boundaries
scope: Show Agent Reach as unavailable, partial, or ready without installing it automatically.
Require explicit user action for installation or system modification.
Keep authenticated and cookie-backed channels disabled by default.
Do not expose credentials, cookies, or the complete host environment to research output or the frontend.
Document which requests are sent to external services such as Jina or Exa.
acceptance_criteria: No application startup or research action invokes agent-reach install --system.
No browser cookie is read without explicit channel configuration.
Health-check errors are actionable and do not block built-in research.
Agent Reach subprocess permissions are limited to the configured research integration.

phases.name: Regression and end-to-end verification
scope: Add focused frontend tests for /research parsing, validation, inline run rendering, and full-report navigation.
Preserve backend tests for run persistence, citation validation, cancellation, resume, and idempotent handoff.
Add integration coverage for healthy, missing, and failing Agent Reach states.
Run formatting, TypeScript tests, Rust tests, and the production build.
acceptance_criteria: The test suite covers start, progress, completion, follow-up handoff, cancel, resume, reload, and Agent Reach fallback.
Existing ordinary chat, Global Chat, and standalone Deep Research behavior has no regression.
pnpm test passes.
cargo test with the src-tauri manifest passes.
pnpm build passes.

required: Existing Deep Research backend and ResearchRun persistence
optional: Agent Reach MCP integration and channel-specific external tools

out_of_scope: Replacing the existing Deep Research engine with Agent Reach.
Creating a second research run store or report page.
Automatically deciding that arbitrary normal prompts are Deep Research requests.
Automatically installing Python, system packages, browser extensions, or Agent Reach dependencies.
Enabling Twitter, Reddit, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Xiaohongshu, or other authenticated channels by default.
Copying or porting every Agent Reach channel implementation into Rust.
Removing the standalone Deep Research page or its history.
definition_of_done: A user can run /research <query> from an ordinary chat without changing modes.
The run is visible, controllable, and readable inline in that chat.
The completed report can be followed up by the same chat agent.
The identical persisted report remains available on the Deep Research page.
Healthy Agent Reach public channels extend source coverage while missing or failing Agent Reach falls back safely.
Security boundaries and authenticated-channel opt-in behavior are documented and tested.
All required tests and the production build pass.
